name: Chicken-Orzo Pasta Sauté with Tomato, Zucchini & Parmesan

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat. Uncover, add salt and orzo, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g orzo pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces.

Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and spices; cook, stirring frequently, until chicken is golden and cooked through, 5-7 minutes. Transfer chicken to a plate and set aside. (Reserve pot with cooking juices for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp butter, unsalted
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 tomatoes
6 medium zucchini squash
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, small dice tomatoes. Place in a large bowl.
Trim and small dice zucchini. Add to the bowl with the tomato.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium yellow onions
6 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Return pot (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat, add more butter, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 4-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp butter, unsalted
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp crushed red pepper
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add cooked orzo, chicken, and broth to the pot with the veggies. Cook, stirring occasionally, until liquid is mostly absorbed, 7-8 minutes.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
When the liquid is mostly absorbed, remove orzo from heat. Add Parmesan and basil, then stir to combine.
To serve, divide orzo sauté between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
